purpose: Teach: 恐ろしく/耐える/説い/ただちに/従わ/免れ/我ら/ですけれど

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、恐ろしく真面目だな
lines.en: Riku, you're weirdly serious about this.
lines.style: Light, teasing drawl. Slight smirk in the voice. Testing him—inviting him to drop the act. Warm underneath the sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、辛い練習に耐えるな、桜
lines.en: You handle those brutal practice sessions better than anyone, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, quietly delivered. No performance. Slight vulnerability beneath—he means it. Brief pause before her name, like he's choosing to say it directly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、後輩に説いてやれよ
lines.en: Come on, you should tell the underclassmen how you do it.
lines.style: Playful challenge. Light, collaborative tone—'we're in this together.' Tilting toward her like she's in on something. Not demanding, inviting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ただちに教室に戻れよ、桜
lines.en: You need to get back to class right now, Sakura.
lines.style: Firmer shift. A trace of real concern beneath the directness. Not scolding—protecting. Said quickly, like he needs her to actually listen this time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ルールに従わないと罰せられるぞ
lines.en: Break the rules and you're going to get in trouble, Riku.
lines.style: Warning with a thin edge of frustration. She's serious now—the teasing dropped. Faster pace. Sounds like she's said this before and it didn't stick.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題を免れる方法考えてるな、桜
lines.en: You're definitely trying to figure out how to skip your homework, aren't you?
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-smile in the voice. He's caught her red-handed and they both know it. Casual, almost affectionate in how unsurprised he sounds.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、我ら部活仲間だな
lines.en: Riku, we're club mates. We're in this together.
lines.style: Softer attack. The teasing gone. Direct, almost vulnerable. Like she's reminding him of something he already knows but needs to hear anyway. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、寝坊ですけれど、教室間に合ったな、桜
lines.en: You overslept again but you still made it to class, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate observation. Slight warmth on 'again'—he's noticed a pattern and doesn't mind. Trailing close, almost under-breath, like a small private acknowledgment.
